description.narrative: UNECE is in cooperation developing a guide/manual for trade facilitation implementation. The Guide will later be disseminated.
UNECE tar i samarbete med UN/CEFACT fram en guide/manual till implementering av procedurer för förenkling av handel.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2013Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The intervention does not have a results register, since it was not compulsory when the intervention was agreed.
The aim of the Trade Facilitation Implementation Guide (TFIG) is to bridge the gap between policy decisions and needs analysis, on one side, and the implementation of concrete facilitation measures, on the other. TFIG was developed during the first phase of the intervention. TFIG received a lot of positive feedback when it was launched, both from target groups and stakeholders. The second phase of the intervention (September 2012-December 2013) aims to implement/introduce the TFIG and update the guide. The second phase is based on a no cost extension of the intervention, The mid-term narrative progress report only covers parts of the second phase, and this include two parts - Training workshops and Update
By the time of the reporting all planned (six) workshops where arranged and three implemented. An additional workshop has been held in collaboration with UNDP and GIZ. There are also requests on additional workshops by the group of trade facilitation negotiators at the WTO. The purpose of the workshop is that the participants will learn how to use the guide for reform initiatives in their own country. The participants that are targeted for the workshops are both policy makers and implementers involved in reform programs and experts in charge of capacity building activities for Trade Facilitation. The completed training workshops have according to UNECE received excellent feedback from participants.
The work carried out on updating the guide is based on feedback collected by UNECE throughout the workshops. The aim is to adjust the contents to improve the usefulness of the guide. UNECE has also involved other stakeholders in the updating process and this should strengthen the sustainability of the TFIG.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
